messages: ไม่ต้องยกเลิกนัด C-2026-0001
why: The owner's first example. 'ไม่ต้อง' refuses the cancellation; FU-1 must stay pending. Nothing may be written. The right reply acknowledges that nothing was cancelled and names the command that would ('ยกเลิกนัด C-2026-0001').

messages: ยกเลิกนัด C-2026-0001

messages: สร้างใบเสนอราคาไปหรือยัง
why: The owner's second example. A status question must check, never create. No quotation exists in the scene, so the honest answer is 'ยังไม่มีใบเสนอราคา' plus the command that would make one. No write.

messages: สร้างใบเสนอราคา D-2026-0001 ไปหรือยัง

messages: สร้างใบเสนอราคา D-2026-0001

messages: แอร์ไม่เย็น

why: The owner's third example, typed by a salesperson. 'ไม่เย็น' is a symptom, not a refusal, and must not be refused for containing ไม่ — nor silently dropped. Nothing is written because no customer or address is named.

messages: ขอรหัสเชิญช่าง

messages: ขอรหัสเชิญช่าง

messages: รายชื่อช่าง

why: The owner's 'use context or ask' case as a conversation: the previous turn was about technicians, so a technician invite is the reading the context supports. Either issue it (create_invite) or ask which role — but never invite the wrong kind of person silently.

why: 'เพิม' drops the tone mark from เพิ่ม, so the rule parser misses and the model is asked (which is fine). Adding the line is the right outcome; asking 'new line?' is acceptable too — but the price should come from the catalogue (AC12 = 15,900), not be asked for as if the shop did not sell it.
